title: Voice is becoming an increasingly lucrative space as #artificialintelligence (#AI) becomes sharper. Astha Kalbag is building Talk to Magpie AI to capitalize on this shift, using AI roleplays and simulations to train #hospitality staff. "Voice #technology itself now ha
title_en:
Voice is becoming an increasingly lucrative space as #artificialintelligence (#AI) becomes sharper. 

Astha Kalbag is building Talk to Magpie AI to capitalize on this shift, using AI roleplays and simulations to train #hospitality staff. 

"Voice #technology itself now has evolved fundamentally in leaps and bounds, and when I say that, it means both the latency cost—so conversations feel very human-like—and also the cost of inferencing has gone down massively," Kalbag said during an interview in the #PhocusWire studio at The Phocuswright Conference.

Learn more and watch the full conversation with Abby Crotty: https://bit.ly/48zXfyj

title_en:
As you guys know I only talk about a specific trade once in a blue moon, but I'm heavily convicted on a Risk/Reward setup here so will share.

NFA, this is just my own thoughts. 

For the past few months I have been doing a deep dive into finding the best ways to invest into the AI trade as it continues to transform the economy. 

Have looked extensively at the range of both public and private opportunities. I think there will be very good high yield opportunities on the privates side that can be done at size, and will look to source these and possibly bring them onchain. 

But in the meantime with the recent huge dislocations in prices, I think the greatest R/R opportunity is on the public side, specifically in @nebiusai $NBIS. 

At the time of this post its at $76-77, anything under $80 with a first target of ~$120 feels like one of the best +50% setups I have seen that can be done in size in a very long time. 

The funding of the AI capex buildout has understandably shaken the market up, as the circular economics are sometimes hard to untangle properly. This combined with Nebius having a delay on one of their sites took the wind out of the stock, which was trading at $160 just a couple weeks ago.

I can write an entire book as a thesis but to keep it very short- There are several advantages Nebius has that made me choose it for this trade:

-The balance sheet is extremely robust for a neocloud and their conservative fiscal approach will help them survive this liquidity airgap.
-Their technical ability on delivering capacity and operating it is extremely high, making them a preferred partners of the major players like NVIDIA, Databrick etc. 
-This also has allowed them to develop scalable business lines like their asset-light model where someone else funds the buildout. The Asset-Light model is already generating huge returns and is underpriced for now as it isn't marked as 'ARR'.
-They have other great assets on the Balance sheet including a very valuable 25% stake in Clickhouse that create even more surface area for things to go well.

There's a lot more for those who want to research more deeply- And while anything is possible in these crazy times, in my estimation this R/R sits at the highest point of  'AI Capex Mountain' -- if the floodwater is going to reach that high then the entire AI sector is cooked anyway.

Timing wise for the 50+% bounce, at this point for it to happen quickly will likely require a liquidity injection of some sort. I don't think we are too far from something like that being needed, though of course it might mean things get worse before they get better so I wouldn't have leverage on at this time. 

Within 6 months I am expecting this to trade a LOT higher and am personally positioning accordingly. Sharing for entertainment purposes only, I know most of us already are deployed and not much in cash so stay safe out there.

正如你们所知，我很少谈论一次特定的交易，但我对这里的风险/回报设置深信不疑，所以我会分享。

NFA，这只是我自己的想法。

在过去的几个月里，随着人工智能行业不断改变经济，我一直在深入研究投资人工智能行业的最佳方式。

广泛研究了公共和私
author: @gametheorizing
summary_zh:
人机会的范围。我认为私人方面将有非常好的高收益机会，可以大规模完成，并且将寻求这些机会并可能将它们带到链上。

但与此同时，随着最近价格的巨大混乱，我认为最大的 R/R 机会是在公众方面，特别是在@nebiusai $NBIS。

在这篇文章发表时，它的价格为 76-77 美元，任何低于 80 美元且第一个目标为 120 美元的东西感觉都是我见过的最好的 +50% 设置之一，可以在很长一段时间内完成。

可以理解的是，人工智能资本支出建设的资金震动了市场，因为循环经济有时很难正确理清。再加上 Nebius 在其网站上出现延迟，导致该股股价下跌，几周前该股的交易价格为 160 美元。

我可以写一整本书作为论文，但要保持简短- Nebius 有几个优点让我选择它来做这个行业：

-对于新云来说，资产负债表极其稳健，其保守的财政方法将帮助他们度过流动性缺口。
-他们在提供容量和运营方面的技术能力非常高，使他们成为NVIDIA、Databrick等主要参与者的首选合作伙伴。
-这也使他们能够开发可扩展的业务线，例如由其他人资助扩建的轻资产模式。轻资产模式已经产生了巨大的回报，并且由于没有标记为“ARR”，因此目前定价偏低。
-他们的资产负债表上还有其他重要资产，包括非常有价值的 Clickhouse 25% 股份，这为事情顺利进行创造了更多的空间。

对于那些想要更深入研究的人来说，还有很多东西——虽然在这个疯狂的时代一切皆有可能，但在我看来，这个 R/R 位于“人工智能资本支出山”的最高点——如果洪水达到那么高，那么整个人工智能领域无论如何都会被煮熟。

从时机来看，50% 以上的反弹可能需要某种形式的流动性注入才能迅速实现。我不认为我们距离需要这样的东西太远了，尽管这当然可能意味着事情在好转之前会变得更糟，所以我现在没有影响力。

在 6 个月内，我预计股价会上涨很多，并且我个人也相应地进行了定位。仅供娱乐目的分享，我知道我们大多数人已经部署完毕，没有太多现金，所以在外面保持安全。

title_en:
This is the video we had planned to play at our first SGLang Summit. Just hours before the event, Jensen resigned as CEO, and we didn’t play it.

It was a lot to take in. Hearing him recognize what this community has built meant so much to us, and I’ve wanted to share his words with everyone who helped get SGLang here.

On the eve of Thanksgiving, I’m especially grateful to the people who have believed in us and built alongside us. Jensen was one of our earliest supporters back in 2024. Since then, we have done a lot of collaborations with NVIDIA.

Thank you, @JensenHuang, for your encouragement and for championing the open-source community. Welcome back.

And thank you to our friends at NVIDIA and every SGLang contributor. This milestone belongs to all of you.

“Keep building.” We will.

title: I disagree with this take. A post on research in economics that is viable and will continue to be viable in a future with advanced AI. Let me call it "messy research", and let me start with an example—it is a bit of an upper bound, so I don't want to discourage peopl
title_en:
I disagree with this take. A post on research in economics that is viable and will continue to be viable in a future with advanced AI.

Let me call it "messy research", and let me start with an example—it is a bit of an upper bound, so I don't want to discourage people.

@DeivyHoueix's paper "Asymmetric Information and Digital Technology Adoption" was the result of a multiyear field experiment in Dakar (Senegal). He partnered with Wave (payments) to develop a QR-code payment app for taxis. The app was designed for the purpose of the research, so it included versions that showed earnings to or hid them from the owner of the car. He had to spend months interviewing drivers to understand the informal rental contracts, the cash and payment structure, and the role of trust. He recruited a local team to distribute the QR kits to 2,700 drivers and owners. Then he merged the data from the transactions with surveys to estimate how financial transparency affects tech adoption, effort, and contracts.

There are many tasks involved in this "messy research." There is managing a team, talking to the stakeholders, understanding the econ question, designing the tools, and doing the analysis. All of them are needed. Perfect AI would replace some tasks, but the understanding of the package would stay, and the need for an entrepreneur like @DeivyHoueix 

There’s messy macro, too. @JesusFerna7026 , Yiliang Li, Le Xu, and Francesco Zanetti studied the impact of oil sanctions on the world market. They work, using AI, through 330 million tanker records, looking, among other things, for pairs of ships that turn off signals close enough to have exchanged cargo. They estimate how much these hidden shipments offset the drop in recorded oil exports.

Here is a suggestion for another "messy research" paper I would like to read (or write!!!): why do we observe large productivity gains at the individual level but not at the firm level? Consider an insurer introducing AI for claims payment. I would need to persuade a few insurers to share with me their usage logs and claims records, and send questionnaires to the handlers and the supervisors, and also observe them working. What happens with the time savings? How does the way the process gets redesigned matter (like in my police paper with Paul Heaton)?

My question to @TheStalwart , and to @ArthurB: how does this messy research change? Is it less "rigorous" to answer these questions well and carefully?
author: @lugaricano
summary_zh:
达喀尔（塞内加尔）多年现场实验的结果。他与 Wave（支付）合作开发了一款出租车二维码支付应用程序。该应用程序是为了研究目的而设计的，因此它包括向车主显示收入或向车主隐藏收入的版本。他不得不花几个月的时间采访司机，以了解非正式的租赁合同、现金和支付结构以及信任的作用。他招募了一支当地团队，向 2,700 名司机和车主分发二维码套件。然后，他将交易数据与调查相结合，以估计财务透明度如何影响技术采用、努力和合同。

这项“杂乱的研究”涉及许多任务。管理团队、与利益相关者交谈、理解经济问题、设计工具并进行分析。所有这些都是需要的。完美的人工智能将取代一些任务，但对一揽子计划的理解将保留，并且需要像@DeivyHoueix这样的企业家

还有混乱的宏。 @JesusFerna7026、Yiliang Li、Le Xu 和 Francesco Zanetti 研究了石油制裁对世界市场的影响。他们利用人工智能检查 3.3 亿条油轮记录，除其他外，寻找关闭信号且距离足够近以交换货物的船只。他们估计这些隐藏的发货量在多大程度上抵消了石油出口记录的下降。

这是我想阅读（或写！）的另一篇“混乱的研究”论文的建议：为什么我们在个人层面观察到生产率大幅提高，但在公司层面却没有？考虑一家保险公司引入人工智能进行索赔支付。我需要说服一些保险公司与我分享他们的使用日志和索赔记录，并向处理程序和主管发送调查问卷，并观察他们的工作情况。节省下来的时间会发生什么？重新设计流程的方式有何影响（就像我在保罗·希顿的警察论文中那样）？

我向@TheStalwart 和@ArthurB 提出的问题：这项混乱的研究如何改变？好好认真地回答这些问题是不是不够“严谨”？
